entries.title: Oil prices fall and shares jump after US-Iran deal announced

entries.title: Norwegian crown princess's son found guilty of two counts of rape
entries.snippet: Marius Borg Høiby, the 29-year-old son of Norway's Crown Princess Mette Marit, has been sentenced to four years in jail.

entries.title: Russian strikes kill 11 and set historic cathedral in Kyiv ablaze
entries.snippet: A Ukrainian drone attack in the Russian city of Tula, south of Moscow, killed three people.

entries.title: Brazil woman dies after rope-jumping instructors fail to attach cord
entries.snippet: Three men have been arrested after instructors failed to attach a rope to her before helping her jump from a bridge.

entries.title: US musician Oliver Tree dies in helicopter collision in Brazil
entries.snippet: The singer-songwriter is among six people presumed dead in air crash over Rio de Janeiro on Sunday.

entries.title: South Korea's Starbucks to shut for staff history lesson after backlash
entries.snippet: The chain was criticised for a "Tank Day" marketing ploy on the anniversary of a military massacre.

entries.title: 'Spider-Man of Yemen' dies falling into volcanic crater
entries.snippet: Al-Qaqa Ibn Antar had been attempting to climb its walls without safety equipment when he fell in, local authorities say.

entries.title: Man apologises for making racist gesture at Korean in World Cup match
entries.snippet: He was caught pulling the corners of his eyes at a South Korean influencer during the match in Mexico.

entries.title: China detains two leaders of influential underground church

entries.title: South African TV star arrested after allegedly kidnapping man in girlfriend dispute

entries.title: Teen shot and buses torched in Manhattan after historic NBA win for Knicks
entries.snippet: At least 63 people were arrested in the disorder after the Knicks beat the Spurs to clinch the title.

entries.title: Swiss voters reject 10 million population cap
entries.snippet: Nearly 55% of participants voted against the proposal to cap population by cutting migration, results show.

entries.title: Trump and thousands of others watch UFC fight on White House lawn
entries.snippet: Justin Gaethje beat Ilia Topuria to win the lightweight championship in the main event.

entries.title: Tourist train overturns and injures 17 during Cártama tapas festival
entries.snippet: Nobody was seriously hurt as a result of the accident in the Spanish town, local authorities say.

entries.title: Fifa to pay Somali referee Artan full World Cup fee
entries.snippet: Somali referee Omar Artan, who was denied entry to the United States to officiate at the World Cup, will still receive his tournament fee from Fifa in full.

entries.title: UK and Japan agree £18bn investment deal
entries.snippet: Japanese firms will spend billions on UK infrastructure and offshore wind, Downing Street says.

entries.title: Norway braces for verdict in rape trial of crown princess's son Høiby
entries.snippet: Marius Borg Høiby will appear via video link, almost three months after his trial came to an end on 40 charges, including four counts of rape.

entries.title: Unclear if US-Iran agreement will provide respite to Lebanon
entries.snippet: Pakistan says the deal includes Lebanon, but recent ceasefires there have failed to take hold.

entries.title: Trump heralds Iran deal but questions - and risks - remain
entries.snippet: The announcement of an Iran deal was a welcome birthday gift for the president – but its success or failure may hinge on the details.

entries.title: Is the convertible heading into the sunset?
entries.snippet: UK drivers have taken a shine to the SUV but could the fate of the convertible be reversed?

entries.title: Former American businessman detained in Myanmar after alleged financial misconduct
entries.snippet: Adam Castillo, founder of AGS Myanmar, was detained Thursday at Yangon International Airport. The U.S. State Department is aware of a reported detention but hasn't commented further.

entries.title: As Luigi Mangione's lawyers head to court, support grows for the accused 'vigilante'
entries.snippet: Luigi Mangione's legal team is back in court in New York City this week for a key pretrial hearing. He's accused of stalking and killing an insurance CEO. Donors have given $1.5 million to support his defense.

entries.title: Trump announces deal to end war in Iran. And, how to stay safe in deadly heat
entries.snippet: Trump says a deal has been reached to end the war between the U.S. and Iran. Plus, this is what extreme temperatures do to the human body — and how you can keep yourself safe.

entries.title: Britain will ban under-16s from social media apps, including TikTok and YouTube
entries.snippet: The ban will apply to platforms including Snapchat, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook and X. The move makes the U.K. part of a growing global movement to tighten online safety for children.

entries.title: U.S. and Iran announce a deal to end the war, reopen Strait of Hormuz
entries.snippet: The deal is a major breakthrough in the conflict that set the Middle East aflame and shook the global economy. However, it did not resolve critical issues set aside for further negotiations.

entries.title: Campaigns are embracing influencers, but internet stardom doesn't always win votes
entries.snippet: It's becoming common for campaigns to seek out viral moments and the support of internet stars to reach new voters. But the strategy, albeit flashy, has yielded mixed results in key races this year.

entries.title: Inside Ebola country: NPR reports from eastern DR Congo's outbreak zone
entries.snippet: In eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, an Ebola outbreak is reshaping life, with fear spreading faster than information and hospitals turning into places of urgent containment rather than care.

entries.title: Most parents track their 18- to 25-year-old kids on their smartphones. Is it healthy?
entries.snippet: A new survey from the University of Michigan asks parents about their use of technology to track their adult children, ages 18-25, including using "always on" location tracking on their smartphones.

entries.title: It's been a thrilling start to the World Cup. Here are the highlights and what's next
entries.snippet: Now that the FIFA World Cup is underway in Mexico, Canada and the U.S., the drama has shifted to the fields, where there have been several surprising results heading into the first full week.

entries.title: Trump celebrates 80th birthday with Iran deal and UFC fights at the White House
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump marked his 80th birthday on Sunday by hailing an initial agreement to end the war in Iran and staging a cage-fighting show on the White House's storied South Lawn.

entries.title: Iran and U.S. reach an initial deal to extend the ceasefire and open the Strait of Hormuz but challenges remain
entries.snippet: Even if the strait fully opens then, it will likely take months for the global energy crisis sparked by its closure to ease.

entries.title: Deal is reached to end Iran war and Trump orders stop to U.S. naval blockade
entries.snippet: Details of the deal were not immediately available. Key mediator Pakistan said the signing will be Friday in Switzerland.

entries.title: Putin and Zelenskyy each speak with Trump by phone as drone strikes kill 2 in Russia and U.K. detains tanker
entries.snippet: Russian President Vladimir Putin and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy each spoke by phone with U.S. President Donald Trump on Sunday.

entries.title: Eastern Congo reports 782 Ebola cases and 181 deaths, authorities say
entries.snippet: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in Congo has increased to 782, with 181 deaths, the Congolese Ministry of Health said in a statement on social platform X on Sunday evening.

entries.title: Taiwan's intelligence agency launches webpage for Chinese nationals to report tips
entries.snippet: Taiwan's intelligence agency said on Sunday it is establishing an information-reporting channel for Chinese nationals to offer tips securely.

entries.title: 12 dead in crash of plane on skydiving outing in Missouri, authorities say
entries.snippet: The crash happened shortly after the plane took off from a local airport around 11:30 a.m., and some of the occupants' family members witnessed the crash, said Bates County Sheriff Chad Anderson.

entries.title: 6 killed after 2 helicopters collide over Rio de Janeiro, singer Oliver Tree on passenger list
entries.snippet: Two helicopters collided over Rio de Janeiro on Sunday morning and crashed in the city's western zone, killing all six people aboard, firefighters said.

entries.title: Britain detains sanctioned oil tanker suspected of ties to Russia's shadow fleet
entries.snippet: Royal Marine commandos rappelled from helicopters onto the vessel, the Smyrtos, in the English Channel, in what the country's Defense Ministry called "the first U.K.-led operation of its kind."

entries.title: Nara Organics recalls baby formula after multistate infant botulism outbreak
entries.snippet: Nara Organics recalled its organic baby formula sold nationwide in Target stores and online Saturday after a multistate outbreak of infant botulism, federal authorities said.

entries.title: Protesters in Geneva clash with police ahead of the G7 summit in nearby France
entries.snippet: A violent standoff extended into the evening after a series of incidents — including a car set ablaze and a bank's windows smashed — along the route of an afternoon march that drew an estimated 20,000 people.

entries.title: Trump celebrates 80th birthday with Iran deal ahead of UFC fights on White House South Lawn
entries.snippet: Trump marked turning 80 on Sunday by hailing an agreement to end the war in Iran hours before a birthday celebration that once would have seemed unfathomable: a cage-fighting show on the South Lawn of the White House.

entries.title: Georgia's vote-counting method will soon be banned. Lawmakers will try to find a fix this week
entries.snippet: Legislators passed a law two years ago barring the use of the QR code printed on ballots that the state relies on to tally votes beyond July 1 of this year, but no replacement method was ever implemented.

entries.title: Palestinian death toll in Gaza tops 73,000, officials say, as Israel strikes despite ceasefire
entries.snippet: Israel says it is targeting Hamas and other militants who pose a threat, and in response to ceasefire violations, including occasional attacks.

entries.title: Knicks win first championship in 53 years, igniting celebrations and chaos in New York City
entries.snippet: New York Knicks won their first NBA championship in 53 years on Saturday night, with exuberant celebrations marred by mayhem and violence, including a shooting in Times Square.

entries.title: Trump taps James M. McDonald as U.S. Attorney for the Southern District of New York
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump said Saturday that he will appoint one of his personal lawyers to serve as the top federal prosecutor in Manhattan.

entries.title: Tens of thousands march at Pride events in Romania and Bulgaria to demand equality
entries.snippet: Romania and Bulgaria do not recognize same-sex marriage or civil partnerships, despite the bloc prohibiting discrimination based on sexual orientation.

entries.title: Ukrainian drone strike kills 1 and injures 3 in southern Russia
entries.snippet: A Ukrainian drone attack killed one person and injured three in Russia's southern Krasnodar region, local officials said Saturday. Drone debris also sparked a fire at a sea terminal, local Gov. Veniamin Kondratyev said.

entries.title: OpenAI hit with multistate probe into possible user harm as its IPO looms
entries.snippet: The company behind the popular chatbot ChatGPT said it will respond to the inquiry "constructively" and that it already has in place measures to protect its customers.

entries.title: Macron to host Trump for dinner at Versailles after G7 summit
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump and French President Emmanuel Macron will meet over dinner at the glittering Palace of Versailles near Paris after the G7 summit next week in France.

entries.title: First-of-its-kind law in New York could block 3D printers from making guns
entries.snippet: A first-of-its-kind law in New York could force 3D printers sold for homes and business to come equipped with technology blocking them from making guns.

entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Ibrahim Maza: Algeria's 'multicultural kid' from Berlin
entries.snippet: Ibo Maza had his choice of three different countries. Instead of his native Germany, the Bayer Leverkusen forward is representing Algeria, the country of his father, at the World Cup in North America.

entries.title: US-Iran: Reported peace deal sparks both relief and anger
entries.snippet: A peace deal between the US and Iran is due to be signed this week — and while the hopes of peace may yet be dashed, the news alone was enough to trigger celebrations, backlash and political infighting on both sides.

entries.title: Iran war: Will the global energy crisis end soon?
entries.snippet: A potential US-Iran deal to end the war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz could ease the global energy crunch, but oil prices and supplies may take months to stabilize as shipping restarts and infrastructure recovers.

entries.title: Germany news: 23 million tune in for World Cup win
entries.snippet: The Germany national team's 7-1 win over Curacao drew over 23 million viewers. Meanwhile, German President Steinmeier is kicking off his visit to Indonesia. Follow DW for more.

entries.title: Mines in the Strait of Hormuz: How dangerous are they?
entries.snippet: There are still mines in the Straight of Hormuz, delaying the opening for commercial shipping. How dangerous are naval mines, and what can be done to clear them?

entries.title: G7: Leaders gather to grapple with wars, global economy
entries.snippet: The heads of the world's richest nations gather in France as the wars in Iran and Ukraine dominate the global agenda. The US has promised peace in Iran; fellow leaders are cautiously optimistic. DW has the latest.

entries.title: The potential of geothermal energy for US homes
entries.snippet: Advancements in geothermal systems and sustained political support in the US provide an opportunity for this clean energy industry to scale.

entries.title: India's Modi in Slovakia, seeks to strengthen trade and investment ties
entries.snippet: Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit to Bratislava marks the first by an Indian leader since Slovakia's "velvet divorce" from the Czech Republic.

entries.title: Iran updates: World leaders express optimism for peace deal
entries.snippet: World leaders have welcomed news of a peace deal that would reopen the Strait of Hormuz to international shipping. However, many details remain unconfirmed. DW has more.

entries.title: Norway: Crown princess's son sentenced to 4 years in prison
entries.snippet: The stepson of Norway's crown prince has been found guilty of two counts of rape and other crimes.

entries.title: Russia strikes leave historic Kyiv cathedral in flames
entries.snippet: The Kyiv Pechersk Lavra monastery, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, was set on fire as Russia struck multiple cities in Ukraine overnight. Meanwhile, Moscow reported three deaths from a Ukrainian drone attack.

entries.title: Trump hosts White House cage fights to mark 80th birthday
entries.snippet: The US president watched seven fights with an audience of 4,000 people inside a specially built arena on the White House lawn. Critics say the unprecendented spectacle is in poor taste amid the ongoing Iran war.

entries.title: US: Skydiving plane crash leaves 12 people dead in Missouri
entries.snippet: A plane on a skydiving excursion crashed in Missouri, leaving 11 passengers and one pilot dead. The incident occurred shortly after the plane became airborne.

entries.title: Iran war: US, Iran announce tentative peace deal
entries.snippet: Pakistani PM Shehbaz Sharif has announced a peace deal between the US and Iran, with a signing ceremony on June 19. Sharif said both sides would terminate military operations, including in Lebanon. DW has more.

entries.title: Manuel Neuer: The aura of a record-breaking goalkeeper
entries.snippet: Germany's hopes at the 2026 World Cup are connected to world-class goalkeeper Manuel Neuer's fitness and form.

entries.title: Germany start 2026 World Cup with win over Curacao
entries.snippet: For the first time since they won the tournament in 2014, Germany won their opening game at the World Cup.

entries.title: Police fire tear gas at anti-G7 protesters in Geneva
entries.snippet: Protesters in Geneva clashed with police, set a car on fire and smashed the windows of a bank to show their opposition to the G7 summit taking place across the border in France.

entries.title: UK seizes suspected Russian shadow fleet tanker
entries.snippet: UK forces on Sunday intercepted a sanctioned Russian ship, with navy commandos rappelling onboard from helicopters. The UK and Ukraine hailed the move, saying it robbed Russia of money for its ongoing war of aggression.

entries.title: Ukraine targets Russia's industrial facilities in massive strike
entries.snippet: Unverified footage on social media showed that a key chemical plant in Russia may have been hit. Meanwhile, the Uk has intercepted a Russian shadow fleet tanker.
